PARAMETER FIXTURES · NO AUTOPLAY

Flash test fixtures

Thirteen deterministic inputs cover frequency, saturated red, contrast and spatial area. One Hz means a complete A → B → A cycle, comprising two transitions.

⚠️ CRITICAL PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING

Warning: deliberate flashing content. Live playback can trigger seizures, migraines, dizziness or nausea. Synthetic tests require no visible playback. Stop controls and brief duration do not make playback safe.

🔒 Locked 


The surface is exactly 1024 × 768 CSS pixels at 100% browser zoom, with controls outside it. It is not scaled to fit. Use a viewport large enough to show the entire surface plus controls; share this tab, then start playback. Full-frame cases fill this reference surface. The capture also includes the static controls and margins.


Area expectations assume the WCAG reference viewing setup: a 341 × 256 field and a 21,824-pixel limit within that field. They are not unconditional safety claims for arbitrary display size, zoom or distance. The app now provides optional calibrated area screening. The small-zone input still produces frequency candidates; the area measurement is reported separately and does not certify conformance.
